title: Training with Harnesses: On-Policy Harness Self-Distillation for Complex Reasoning
harness_design: Deterministic stateful LLM program; draft-verify and plan-solve style harnesses
harness_change: Fixed structure; behavior changes with current model
harness_in_rollout: Yes, teacher harness generates training supervision
internalization_evidence: Strong: standalone model improves; reattaching harness gives little/no benefit
notes: Key evidence that external harness capability can be internalized into model weights.

title: Co-Harness: Co-Evolving Harnesses and Model Weights for LLM Agents
harness_design: Prompts, tools, skills, middleware, memory; runtime research-agent harness
harness_change: Yes: LLM HarnessCritic proposes and validates local harness updates
rl_algorithm: None reported as core model-update method
training_method: Alternating harness optimization and model fine-tuning on improved trajectories
benchmark: Automated AI research case study; paper-specific evaluations TBD
internalization_evidence: Moderate: effective scaffolding is distilled into model parameters via fine-tuning
notes: Closest direct prior on harness-model alternating co-evolution.

title: Agent Lightning v1.0: Towards Harnessed Agentic RL
harness_design: Arbitrary deploy-time harness owns tools, context, control flow and environment loop
harness_change: Usually fixed by user/deployment; framework trains policy under the real harness
rl_algorithm: veRL-compatible harnessed agentic RL; exact optimizer/config tracked per experiment
training_method: RL with proxy-captured LLM request/response trajectories
notes: Core infrastructure baseline for training with a real deploy-time harness.

title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
harness_design: Arbitrary stateful/multi-process harness; OpenAI-compatible proxy records model calls
harness_change: Harness generally fixed during policy training
rl_algorithm: Standard RL backend such as veRL
training_method: Proxy-recorded harness-native RL + Kubernetes rollout orchestration
code: Official open-source repo link to pin
notes: Alternative infrastructure baseline to Agent Lightning; does not optimize harness.

title: Harness-RL: Black-Box Reinforcement Learning with Action-Args Decoupling for Central-Agent Multi-Agent Harnesses
category: Harnessed Agentic RL; Multi-Agent RL; RL Algorithm
harness_design: Central agent coordinates sub-agents/tools; Interface Call Records + prefix trees represent branching/parallel sessions
harness_change: Harness structure given; policy trained inside it
training_method: Structured black-box trajectories + action/args gradient decoupling
benchmark: Seven multi-hop QA and agentic retrieval benchmarks
notes: Important RL baseline for complex/non-flat harness trajectories; no harness evolution.

title: EvoHarness-RL: Learning Self-Evolving Runtime Harness for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
category: Harness Policy Learning; Harnessed Agentic RL; Harness Evolution
harness_design: BPE external state: Belief, Progress, Experience; policy-facing actions to read/write harness state
harness_change: Experience/progress state evolves; action set and core BPE interface fixed
reward: Task success + efficiency/cost-aware terms + auxiliary shaping
internalization_evidence: Weak/indirect: harness usage anneals during RL; no harness-free causal removal test reported
component_retirement: No structural component retirement; usage can fall toward zero
code: No official repo confirmed as of 2026-09-04
notes: Most direct collision with RL + harness annealing; reported compute: 8 H200, 150 epochs, 128 trajectories/step.

title: CHILL-Harness: Counterfactual Harness Learning for Efficient Reasoning in Long-Horizon Agents
harness_design: Base agent + counterfactual planner + learned router/change/stop/intervention policies
harness_change: Yes: runtime workflow intervention/adaptation; base model weights not the main target
rl_algorithm: None for base model; offline learned controller policies
training_method: Offline paired counterfactual data + learned intervention-effect predictors
notes: Useful checkpointed paired interventions; asks which workflow to use rather than whether model still needs a capability.

title: SafeEvolve: Harness-Policy Co-Evolution from Agent Experience for Safety Alignment
harness_design: Safety prompt + hierarchical skills as bounded/reversible harness artifacts
harness_change: Yes: trajectory safety evidence updates harness components
internalization_evidence: Claims stronger autonomous safety behavior; strict harness-removal evidence TBD
notes: Explicit experience-driven harness-policy co-evolution with SFT+RL.

title: JIT-Agent: Scaling Harness Intelligence via Just-in-Time Harness Evolution
category: Harness Generation; Harness Evolution; Harness Intelligence
harness_design: Four-module machine-generatable harness protocol covering memory, planning, action protocol, tool/skill orchestration
harness_change: Yes: synthesized, repaired and self-evolved per task/archive
rl_algorithm: Not served-agent RL; dedicated harness intelligence model
component_retirement: Harness configurations replaced, not model-side retirement
notes: Alternative thesis: scale harness intelligence as a trainable/compounding capability layer.

title: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces
harness_design: Prompts, tool definitions/implementations, middleware hooks, agent-loop logic
training_method: Failure diagnosis + Capability/Steering patches + validation selection + EvoDAG evolution
component_retirement: Harness logic may be replaced; not model-side handoff
notes: Reported +9.0/+9.6/+10.0 pp; strong structural harness-optimization baseline with fixed model weights.

title: StarHarness: Evolving Harnesses with Stratified Search for Enterprise Environments
harness_design: Prompts/task framing, tool interfaces, skills, MCP providers, subagent structure, agent-loop configuration
training_method: Stratified search + hidden selection + held-out evaluation
benchmark: ITBench SRE; EnterpriseOps-Gym ITSM; AutomationBench Finance
component_retirement: Harness edits accepted/rejected; not model-side handoff
notes: Broad structural evolution; reports 20-35 pp gains after 4-12 accepted changes and cross-model transfer.

title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
harness_design: Programmable plug-in layer around frozen environment; EnvRigger synthesizes components from policy trajectories
component_retirement: Environment components can change; not model capability retirement
notes: Extends co-evolution picture from model-harness to policy-environment.

title: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness
category: Harness-Aware Training; Agentic Post-Training; Evolving Harness
harness_design: Skills, Hooks, system prompts and tools decoupled from weights
benchmark: Live-Stream QA; Harness-Variant QA; IFEval; production evaluations
internalization_evidence: Robustness to changing harness; not direct component absorption proof
notes: Industrial recipe combining evolving-harness exposure, OPD and RL; replay latency reported on one H20.

title: ReSkill: Reconciling Skill Creation with Policy Optimization in Agentic RL
category: Skill-Policy Co-Evolution; Agentic RL; Skill Evolution
harness_design: External trigger-based skill library loaded per turn
training_method: veRL-based GRPO with RL-in-the-loop skill creation
internalization_evidence: Not primarily internalization; policy and external skills co-adapt
notes: Major collision with generic skill-policy co-evolution; pruning is not automatically causal proof of internalization.

title: Dynamic Dual-Granularity Skill Bank for Agentic RL (D2Skill)
category: Skill Bank; Agentic RL; Paired Rollouts; Skill Evolution
harness_change: Yes: expands, retrieves, updates and prunes
rl_algorithm: Agentic RL with paired skill utility signal
training_method: Paired baseline and skill-injected rollouts under same policy
reward: Environment reward + hindsight utility from performance gap
internalization_evidence: Paired gap measures skill utility; not strict model-side absorption proof
notes: Very close prior for with-skill/without-skill measurement; EMNLP 2026 Main.

title: SKILLC: Learning Autonomous Skill Internalization in LLM Agents via Contrastive Credit Assignment
category: Skill Internalization; Agentic RL; Credit Assignment
harness_design: Structured external skill prompts used during training and withdrawn for autonomous inference
harness_change: Active skill types are adaptively pruned
training_method: Paired skill-injected + skill-free rollouts + contrastive credit + adaptive curriculum
reward: Task reward plus assisted-vs-autonomous contrast in advantage estimation
internalization_evidence: Strong: explicitly evaluates without runtime skill access
notes: Directly targets autonomous skill internalization; substantially narrows novelty for simple paired handoff/retirement ideas.
